user_prompt: We need to orchestrate the launch of our new product line, ensuring that procurement sources quality raw materials that meet our standards, engineering designs and validates the components, operations sets up manufacturing processes, and sales prepares go-to-market strategies. Additionally, the process should include coordinating any engineering modifications and material lifecycle changes across departments to keep everything synchronized. Can you help us design a workflow that handles all of these moving parts together?
